description: This file defines a module for processing challenge files, specifically adding seed content and handling editable region markers within challenge files for a coding platform.

methods.name: findRegionMarkers
methods.description: Identifies the line numbers of editable region markers in a challenge file content.

methods.name: removeLines
methods.description: Removes specified lines from the content based on line indices.

methods.name: addSeeds
methods.description: Main function returning a transformer that processes challenge trees to add seed content and handle editable regions.

methods.name: validateEditableMarkers
methods.description: Validates that lines with editable region markers are correctly formatted and not duplicated.
